incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired: LATENCY_THRESHOLD for route=/v1/generate, p99=3.2s (> SLO 1.9s). SLO burn=27%. Region=apac-east. Pager: PAGERDUTY-INC-12091

dave (oncall): acknowledged on PD and here. I'm on-call for next 60. Starting quick triage — can someone check recent deploys and autoscaler events? @carol @ben

carol (eng-runtime): checking now. seeing increased queue length on batcher sidecars in apac-east. KV cache eviction spikes at ~12:07UTC. no obvious OOMs yet.

ben (eng-sre): infra looks healthy CPU/GPU not saturated. Autoscaler did one small scale-up at 12:05UTC but backpressure persisted. routing shows apac-edge -> apac-east pool, no recent config changes.

alice (devex): deploy-bot: release/eng-runtime@c3a9f8 rolled at 11:59UTC to apac-east (canary->gradual). Noticed increased median latency in canary metrics around 12:02UTC.

dave (oncall): good find. Carol — can you pin canary out or flip fallback to older runtime variant for apac-east? If quick rollback possible, do it. Otherwise we should divert traffic to eu-west temporarily.

carol (eng-runtime): trying staged rollback to c3a9f8 previous sha b2f1d0. If rollback fails, will open diversion patch to route 40% traffic to eu-west.

ben (eng-sre): preparing traffic diversion playbook: 1) add route override 2) warm eu-west pool 3) monitor p95/p99. ETA 3-4 min to shift 40%.

eva (customer-success): getting 3 customer reports (APAC) of timeouts/slow responses. They escalated to support lead. Sharing contact list for follow-up: acct-01, acct-42.

carol (eng-runtime): rollback applied to canary at 12:14UTC. Confirming rollout STOP for apac-east canary. watch metrics for next 2 minutes.

dave (oncall): acked. thanks. Ben, hold off diversion until we see if rollback resolves.

incident-bot: Noted metric change: p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.1s at 12:16UTC (post-rollback). SLO burn now 2%.

dave (oncall): looks like rollback helped. I'll keep incident open for 30m to watch. Carol please open a follow-up runbook item to root-cause canary validation gap. Alice can you capture the canary dashboard + regression test failure?

alice (devex): will capture screenshots and the failing prompt set. adding to #postmortems board and assigning to eng-runtime.

ben (eng-sre): creating temporary alert mute for this noisy threshold in apac to avoid autopage spam while we tune canary checks.

eva (customer-success): updating affected customers that we've mitigated and will follow up with RCA.

dave (oncall): closing PD incident after watch window. If p99 stays below 1.9s for 30m, I'll mark resolved and file follow-up. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-12091 status: RESOLVED by dave (oncall) at 12:46UTC. Duration: 42m.
